data.narrative:
Intuitive Machines is a space and aerospace company at the SPAC stage that has raised $305M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private comparables including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though the narrow peer set for Intuitive Machines' specific stage and tier is constrained.

Traditional peer-median analysis is inapplicable here: only 2 same-stage comparables exist in Space & Aerospace, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is also unavailable—the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 23.9x revenue across 6 tickers, but Intuitive Machines' revenue is not disclosed, preventing multiple application. Without either method yielding quantitative results, this analysis cannot triangulate to a defensible valuation range.

The binding constraint is data scarcity: the company operates in a thin sector where late-stage private companies rarely disclose revenue, and stage-specific peer clustering is insufficient. A complete valuation would require either disclosed or modeled revenue figures to anchor to public multiples, or identification of 2+ additional private peers with known funding rounds and valuations at comparable stages. Until these inputs materialize, quantitative synthesis remains unwarranted.
